study type: Retrospective analysis of a cohort (diagnostic accuracy study)
outcome: Positive predictive value (PPV) of GDM diagnosis
Negative predictive value (NPV) of GDM diagnosis
cohort: The study included 2,159 mothers from the DREMBee study, comprising 803 diagnosed with GDM after 24 gestational weeks and 1,356 with normal glucose tolerance.
finding: The Japanese COVID-19 GDM strategy for GDM diagnosis after 24 weeks of gestation showed a sensitivity of 35.4% and specificity of 90.5%, suggesting its potential usefulness in emergency situations, with HbA1c and FPG identified as risk factors for GDM requiring insulin therapy.
